gloss: to sit down; to take a seat

definitions.gloss: to sit down; to take a seat; to settle down
definitions.explanation: To lower oneself into a sitting position. More literary or deliberate than {座|すわ}る, often implying carefully or comfortably settling into a seat.

examples.japanese: ⟦ベンチ→ベンチ：00013_benchi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{腰|こし}→腰：02210_koshi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{下|お}ろした→下ろす：02029_orosu⟧。
examples.english: I sat down on a bench.

examples.japanese: ⟦どうぞ→どうぞ：02920_douzo⟧、⟦そちら→そちら：00990_sochira⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{腰|こし}→腰：02210_koshi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{下|お}ろして→下ろす：02029_orosu⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please, have a seat over there.

examples.japanese: ⟦{疲|つか}れた→疲れる：00901_tsukareru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{木陰|こかげ}→木陰：05043_kokage⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{腰|こし}→腰：02210_koshi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{下|お}ろして→下ろす：02029_orosu⟧⟦{休憩|きゅうけい}→休憩：00262_kyuukei⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I was tired, so I sat down in the shade of a tree and took a break.

notes:
USAGE:
The verb ⟦{下|お}ろす→下ろす：02029_orosu⟧ conjugates normally as a godan verb. This expression is more descriptive and slightly more formal or literary than simply ⟦{座|すわ}る→座る：00757_suwaru⟧ (to sit). It draws attention to the physical action of lowering oneself.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ～⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{腰|こし}を{下|お}ろす (to sit down on/at ~)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{座|すわ}る→座る：00757_suwaru⟧ is the everyday word for sitting down
- {腰|こし}を{下|お}ろす emphasizes the deliberate act of settling into a seat, often used in narrative writing
- ⟦{腰|こし}→腰：02210_koshi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{掛|か}ける is a similar expression, slightly more formal
